description: This Java class 'BasicAndroidKeyStoreFragment' manages Android Key Store operations including key creation, signing, and verification within an Android Fragment. It handles key generation with different APIs depending on Android version, signs data, and verifies signatures, primarily for secure cryptographic operations.

classes.name: BasicAndroidKeyStoreFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages cryptographic key generation, signing, and verification using the Android Key Store system.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets options menu and default alias.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Lifecycle callback when activity is created.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for creating keys, signing data, and verifying signatures.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates a public/private key pair and stores it in the Android Key Store, with different implementations depending on Android version.

methods.name: signData
methods.description: Signs input data using the stored key pair and returns a Base64-encoded signature.

methods.name: verifyData
methods.description: Verifies input data against a provided signature using the stored key pair.

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias used to identify the key in the Key Store.
